_about: Queue settings for pull_queues.py --state KS. name is the State/Province value in the GEM export; markets are the queues read (all of Kansas is in SPP: Evergy, Sunflower Electric, Kansas Electric Power Cooperative, Midwest Energy, Kansas Power Pool and the Kansas City Board of Public Utilities); owner and shared_owner are only used for MISO, which does not reach Kansas, so both are empty; pjm_states is empty; known is hand-checked patterns, GEM plant id to regexes that name that plant in a point of interconnection, project name or developer, empty until the first Kansas queue run is checked. Every match still says check.
name: Kansas
